editorial_reading.summary: As Vessel descends into the ocean, we also see him sinking further into his subconscious, unravelling scattered memories before Sleep wipes him of his pain. While The Love You Want emulates a lush, euphoric piano ballad, it highlights a profuse imbalance of power in his past relationship.
